components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main nomination and research action with compressed display type and hard lift.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary" type="button">REVIEW NOMINATION <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h15M13 5l7 7-7 7" /></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-width: 260px; min-height: 62px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); padding: 0 22px; background: var(--coral); color: #fff; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .015em; text-transform: uppercase; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 30px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: var(--shadow); } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 1.25em; height: 1.25em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px var(--blue); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: .65; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A square, transparent companion action used for returning to edit.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 62px; padding: 0 22px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 3px solid var(--ink); font-family: var(--body); font-weight: 900; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: transparent; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px var(--blue); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: .65; box-shadow: none; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-link { min-width: 132px; padding: 15px 22px 11px; border-left: 1px solid var(--ink); color: inherit; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: var(--body); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 850; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; } .ds-nav-link:last-child { border-right: 1px solid var(--ink); } .ds-nav-number { color: var(--blue); font-family: var(--meta); font-weight: 800; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--yellow); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px var(--blue); }

components.name: Submission Mode Switch
components.description: A two-choice submission control whose pressed state uses the selected hard-lift pattern.
components.css: .ds-mode-switch { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--body); } .ds-mode-choice { min-height: 100px; background: transparent; color: inherit; border: 2px solid var(--ink); padding: 16px; text-align: left; font-weight: 900; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mode-detail { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-weight: 500; font-size: .78rem; } .ds-mode-choice[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--yellow); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--ink); transform: translate(-2px, -2px); } .ds-mode-choice:hover { border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-mode-choice:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px var(--blue); }

narrative.overview:
The Public Scouting Program treats every screen-story nomination as a physical piece of cultural evidence: a festival handbill, an open-call ticket, a contact sheet, or a research receipt. The atmosphere is energetic, tactile, and editorial—acid color fields and compressed headlines bring underground-magazine conviction, while explicit labels, program numbers, and visible rules keep the experience evidence-aware.

The system joins Letterboxd-like cultural fluency, Sundance-like programming authority, Are.na-like collected context, and neobrutalist construction without mimicking any one reference. Warm paper, near-black ink, square geometry, hard seams, restrained grain, and controlled offset shadows form one public identity; analytical surfaces become calmer through density and color restraint, not through a separate visual language. Generic centered AI heroes, floating glass cards, gradients, and decorative AI-orb imagery are outside this world.
keyCharacteristics: Compressed, all-caps display type paired with sturdy sans-serif reading copy and monospaced evidence labels.
Warm paper and near-black ink interrupted by acid yellow, electric blue, and signal coral.
Contact-sheet grids, ticket cuts, program numbers, hard rules, and selectively lifted actions.
Explicit status language and semantic structure carry meaning alongside color, border, and motion.
One low-opacity paper-and-ink grain adds tactility without competing with content.

rules.name: The Ink Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Electric blue indicates mission or process, acid yellow indicates public programming or selection, and signal coral indicates nomination action; do not scatter the accents as interchangeable decoration.

rules.name: The Paper Stays Warm Rule
rules.body: Warm program paper is the default canvas. Clean white is reserved for contrast and field clarity rather than used as a generic page background.

rules.name: The Poster Leads, the Receipt Proves Rule
rules.body: Use the compressed face for cultural invitation and hierarchy; use mono for metadata and evidence; keep explanatory prose in the reading face.

rules.name: The Continuous Program Rule
rules.body: Build sections as adjacent fields joined by rules; use white space inside the fields, not floating rounded containers between them.

rules.name: The Flat Until Lifted Rule
rules.body: A surface earns an offset shadow only when it is an action, a selected control, or the signature nomination ticket.

rules.name: The Paper Is Cut, Not Cushioned Rule
rules.body: Keep primary UI geometry square and use print-production details for character; rounded rectangles and pill-shaped containers do not belong in the implemented system.

rules.name: The State Must Speak Rule
rules.body: Pair visual state with live labels, semantic attributes, and adjacent explanation; color, shadow, and motion are never the only carriers of meaning.

dos: Do use compressed headlines, plain reading copy, and mono metadata for distinct rhetorical jobs.
Do build continuous program fields with exact rules, deliberate asymmetry, and square corners.
Do reserve hard shadows for actions, selections, and the signature nomination ticket.
Do keep evidence, source, claim, Demo, Sample, and error labels visible in live text.
Do preserve the stepped handoff as the single recurring motion and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glass panels, AI orbs, soft floating cards, or generic dashboard bento grids.
Don't turn saturated accents into decoration; each ink has an implemented semantic role.
Don't soften the system with pill controls or a family of rounded rectangles.
Don't use texture, imagery, borders, shadows, or motion as the sole carrier of status or evidence.
Don't imply festival affiliation, creator endorsement, verification, or audience proof through decorative program language.
